issues: Both pages were grey wireframe placeholder dashboards with no content, so you couldn't tell what the tear changed
On the light grey page the light/dark ghosts barely showed; the tear just looked like the page shaking, with no signal-glitch texture
Every displaced strip got a bright edge, so the peak frame was covered in horizontal lines like ruled paper
The hard cut sat in the decay (58f) when displacement was already small, so it was poorly masked
changes: Dark midnight look; the two pages are one release console in two states: "Rolling out Halo 4.0" stuck at 99% with 17/18 regions lit, then "Halo 4.0 is live." with 18/18 lit teal and p95 41ms, so the tear reads as the moment of going live
Mono, technical layout: 132px headline, 196px mono figure, a traffic/latency curve in the middle, an 18-cell region bar and 32px log/stat rows, on the same grid in both states

Ghosts became two-colour silhouettes (teal and electric-blue single-colour copies of the content, ±12px, screen) that move with each strip; only heavily torn strips get a cut edge, plus two scan lines per frame
New timing: 30–31f precursor jitter while progress hangs at 99%, tear attacks at 44f, hard cut at 54f inside full-amplitude shaking (exposure lift plus a 1.6% punch-in), unmask at 60f
Aftermath: a teal wave runs across the region cells, p95 counts 58→41ms, three stats rise in stagger; the hold has a Live ping and a 1.8% slow push
